notes.title: Version 1.3.3 Update
notes.content:
Dear Guards,
We would like to inform you about the next update schedule.

[h2]■ Additions and Adjustments[/h2]
- Adjusted the experience points required for base level progression.
- Added an icon to make location easier to identify when a tame chance occurs outside the field of view or when the tame chance target moves off-screen

[h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Revised the text for the heavy machine gun to make it clearer.
- Fixed an issue where "Special" was incorrectly excluded from the Yellow Plan's target list.
- Addressed a bug that could cause the game to freeze when entering a camp.
　　The root cause has been identified and fixed, but it may still occur in specific environments. If it happens, please report it along with your environmental details.
- Fixed a bug where the Curse Dragon's buff was mistakenly applied to "Dragons" instead of "Large Carnivores."
- Resolved an issue where buttons on the left side of the screen became unresponsive.
- Fixed a bug where buffs obtained from camps were removed after using ride skills.

[h2]■ Known Issues (Currently Being Addressed)[/h2]
- Buffs other than camp buffs may also be removed when using ride skills.- Ingredients can become immovable or appear semi-transparent and fail to cook while bulk-preparing food in camp.
- Tools created but never used in exploration before quitting the game may become unregistered in the encyclopedia upon the next startup.
- Abnormal display interactions between Josette's armor and Arise armor.
- A bug where the number of materials obtained becomes zero when achieving "Great Success" during dismantling.

- The description text in the Arise encyclopedia may be incomplete or cut off midway.

[h2]■ Investigating Issues (Not Yet Reproduced)[/h2]
- Josette's main and sub-weapons disappearing unexpectedly, with no option for reproduction.
- Incorrect display of Arise after breeding in the Arise Center.
- While in a stage, attempting to open the status screen for the second or later party member instead opens the first member's status.
- Arise level-ups may not immediately update their stats in the status screen.
When locking Arise in the breeding screen, the lock icon on the right side of the screen may not update instantly.

We are continuing to investigate and address other confirmed issues that have been reported.

Please continue to enjoy the world of Struggle F.O!

Struggle F.O Development Team

notes.title: Ver.1.3.2 Update
notes.content:
Dear Guards,
We would like to inform you about the next update schedule.

[h2]■ Update[/h2]
- Introduced a feature to check race prize details.
- Added an ON/OFF toggle for auto-equipped items.
- Adjusted the timing of the tutorial related to interactions.
- Adjusted the buff and debuff effects caused by perceived temperature changes.
- Adjusted light item consumption (e.g., torches) to occur only upon entering nighttime maps.

- Added and corrected achievement-related text for various languages.
- Fixed an issue where background music (BGM) in rare desert fields would not stop when switching to normal BGM.
- Fixed a bug where some Arise characters would not get lost as intended.
- Fixed an issue where the museum’s BGM would stop after returning to the Arise list following a conversation event.
- Fixed a problem where pressing the Enter key allowed unintended confirmations during full army retreats, along with related bugs.
- Corrected a bug in the museum where Arise characters with day/night switchable animations would remain in their daytime form.
- Fixed a bug where filter settings would reset entirely after a breeding operation.
- Fixed an issue where trigger button inputs would still register even after releasing the button.
- Resolved a problem where achievements requiring legendary items were incorrectly set to rarity level 3 (common), and where workshop creations were not counted.
- Corrected the naming of “Allies” and “Smalit” in several languages.
- When obtaining the original color of a race prize, it will now be automatically locked.


Please continue to enjoy the world of Struggle F.O!

Struggle F.O Development Team

notes.title: Major Update Part 2!
notes.content:
Dear Guards,

Struggle F.O's second major update, Ver.1.2.0 "Snowfield Area Unlocked," has finally been implemented! This update is available for free to all players.

[h2]■Snowfield PV[/h2]
[previewyoutube=V34Fjc8YlPM;full][/previewyoutube]
Japanese/English Subtitles.

[h2]■New Adventure Land![/h2]
The new land is a frigid, icy wasteland. 
Be cautious of severe weather conditions such as blizzards and thunderstorms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/3c21d0aab5153a411832845886a199f0097d6f8f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/c8e76d479a2b8e938066ca24d723e9e08cb56134.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/01b82ba50278c762410d8fc4ad95f889a597d95a.jpg[/img]

The snowfield area is extremely cold, so make sure to prepare armor with high cold resistance.
Materials for highly effective cold-resistant armor can be gathered from the volcano and snowfield areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/898090ead6d44db8383ed08cad486d618c6c9dcf.jpg[/img]
Thick Leather Equipment / Reinforced Armor Equipment / Fur Equipment

[h2]■Materials from the Snowy Field Area[/h2]
Unique materials from the snowy field area will also become available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/24a2f886dfeb40c27df4d8a58e7597fc3232a3d0.jpg[/img]

[h2]■New Rare Fields[/h2]
In the snowy field area, four new rare fields will be introduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/621e6888bb9fac5e616e587abd5ac497486baf6b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/90cb977ad293971e4facb0594efc01f47b2ab787.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/ae70628690b8696d1123a128816ec61b03c45670.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/240a3c177e14b2986c125010d73ba89caef6e96b.png[/img]

[h2]■雪原エリアに生息するアライズたち[/h2]
新たに15種類のアライズが追加されます。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/aa3bf8f3c564659c2ed24f82ef012bbc77bc5b3d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/d15dfc6893b690bd4cb1845b6942a0cb7f37e234.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/16fc66b8aef997200c860df11046e5007a055e23.jpg[/img]

[h2]■New Conversation Drama Added[/h2]
When Ren (Lady Grey) is recruited as an ally, the conversation drama for that character will be unlocked in the library.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/a478013cdc0ed1a5bd1d2f153bc6a3833bbea49b.png[/img]

[h2]■Main Implementations and Adjustments[/h2]
- Improved team formation operability on the stage selection screen.
- Shortened the zoom & slow-motion effects when defeating mid-bosses.
- Changed the rare enemy defeat effect from zoom & slow to a cut-in effect.
- Enhanced the speech bubble animation effect during tame chance occurrences.
- Moved the save deletion function to the options button and added a double-check feature.
- Added two items to increase Josette's health.
- Added attack type (ranged, melee, etc.) indication in the detailed screen during Arise formation.
- Optimized battle processing.
- Added walking animation for enemies.
- Adjusted the color of skill-holding enemies.
- Added an effect to make it easier to identify ally Arise positions.
- Added load reduction processing when the number of possessed Arise exceeds a certain number.
- Increased the debuff application rate of Raphael's normal attacks.
- Added snowy field area.
- Added snowy field dungeon.
- Implemented snowy field boss.
- Added 15 new Arise.
- Changed the ending conditions to clearing all bosses up to the snowy field on β mode.
　　* The ending will not play a second time if it has already been reached once.
- Added an epilogue.
　　* The epilogue conditions are to clear each boss on δ mode.
- Strengthened the normal attack power of the Mad Engineer.
- Adjusted the required materials for Mad Engineer's Arise equipment (changed from snowy field exclusive materials to volcanic exclusive materials).

The required specifications have been slightly adjusted in this update.

[h2]■Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed some achievement-related bugs.
- Corrected the appearance location of Len (Royal Milk Tea) from "snowy field" to "volcano."
- Fixed wording in role description tips where the control was incorrectly listed as a controller (Japanese only).
- Fixed a bug where Kangardon was included in the drop list of the normal stages in the volcano.
- Fixed a bug where the Mad Engineer's skill effects were not activating correctly.
- Fixed a bug where sorting in the Craft shop could prevent processing.
- Adjusted some English texts to be more understandable.
- Fixed a bug where the experience points required for the next level-up were not properly increasing.

[h2]■Other Progress[/h2]
- The work to improve Chinese translations is currently ongoing.
　　We are requesting a review and adjustment of the existing translation quality.
　　Completion is expected between January and February 2025.
- The improvement of English translations is also being carried out as needed.
- Additionally, we are progressing with additions and adjustments based on the year-end and New Year plans.

　[b]■ Relevant Page[/b]
　[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2633080?emclan=103582791474269327&emgid=4444585538764145527]Year-End and New Year Update Plans[/url]

[h2]■Known Issues (In Progress)[/h2]
- When selecting multiple items for repair, the necessary materials do not fit within the display frame, making it difficult to notice missing materials.
　　Current workaround: Perform repairs individually or change the selection order for correct display.
　　Adjustment in progress to display missing materials at the top.
- It will be possible to breed between Wanko and Fear Wolf, but currently, only Fear Wolf offspring can be produced.
　　In a future update, the "Fear Wolf Subspecies" will be added.
　　The Fear Wolf Subspecies will have the same skill set as Wanko (without the Undead attribute).
- If the Grand Mage's ride is canceled, the electric shock damage decreases significantly.
　　After canceling the ride, the attack power of Josette is referenced, so the power decreases as per current specifications.
　　If the ride remains, the damage is based on the Grand Mage's attack power.
　　Additionally, buffs will not take effect unless the ride state is maintained until the casting is complete.
　　We are considering adjustments to improve usability.

Explore the uncharted areas and welcome powerful allies! 
Continue enjoying the world of Struggle F.O!

notes.title: First Major Update!
notes.content:
Dear Guards,

The first major update for Struggle F.O, Ver.1.1.0 "Volcano Area Release," is finally here! This update is free and will be available to all players!

[h2]■New friends.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/617ef7637118e52eb9555f25da494a6e27103daf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/b2af2b8d52de16906aaf66020be5b04bab77d56a.jpg[/img]

[u][b]※Since Nia is considered a general Arise character, it is recommended to lock her if you wish to keep her.[/b][/u]

[h2]■A New Land for Adventure![/h2]

[h2]■Materials from the Volcano Area[/h2]

　　Decagorix: Shooting → obstruction

notes.title: Release of DLC 'Blade of Shadow and Heart of Righteousness'!
notes.content:
[h1]"The DLC 'Blade of Shadow and Heart of Righteousness' is out today![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/6ba579de454763a4e3a9e345e71408235919bee0.png[/img]

Two new allies from medieval Edo join the world of 'Struggle F.O'.

[b]Sennosuke[/b], a samurai aiming to rise through the ranks and become a warrior with just his sword skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/82297fb42a1acd3160f8b4c47701666e6fe94db7.jpg[/img]

[b]Yosuke[/b], who was freed from an unfortunate situation by a ninja and, out of gratitude, became a ninja himself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/5c4637f01c01dcec173508695b3cd149859b377e.jpg[/img]

The two were transported to this world by a certain event and are traveling through dangerous fields, desperately aiming for human settlements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/61b921129b4b239bf90ff8a973a9df0722761869.png[/img]
You may encounter them around the mysterious structure 'Dome Ruins', which brought them to this world.

If you successfully persuade them, they will become powerful allies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/73fea5994953d032c4136939953d6881b4a4f3c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747919/22080382a8c72d413299c0dd2e3b133d74182c30.png[/img]

When you see them, be sure to challenge yourself to make them your allies!
